data.headline: NYSE American grants IHT compliance-plan extension

claims.text: On September 10, 2026, InnSuites Hospitality Trust received notice that its compliance plan was accepted and granted a plan period through December 24, 2027.

citation.quote: On September 10, 2026, InnSuites Hospitality Trust (the “Trust”) received written notice from NYSE American LLC (“NYSE American”) indicating that the Compliance Plan submitted by Trust has been accepted by NYSE Regulation and grant a plan period (“Plan Period”) through December 24, 2027 (“Plan Period Deadline”).

claims.text: The Trust is currently out of compliance with NYSE American continued listing standards, but its listing continues under the extension.

citation.quote: The Trust is not in compliance with NYSE American continued listing standards currently, but its listing is being continued pursuant to an extension.

claims.text: If compliance is not restored by December 24, 2027, or progress is insufficient during the plan period, NYSE Regulation staff could initiate delisting proceedings.

citation.quote: If the Company is not in compliance with the continued listing standards by the Plan Period Deadline (December 24, 2027), or if the Company does not make progress consistent with the plan during the Plan Period, NYSE Regulation staff could initiate delisting proceedings as appropriate.

claims.text: The notice has no immediate effect on IHT’s NYSE American listing or trading, subject to compliance with other continued listing requirements.

citation.quote: The notice has no immediate effect on the listing or trading of the Trust’s shares of beneficial interest on NYSE American, subject to the Trust’s compliance with NYSE American’s other continued listing requirements.

claims.text: IHT said it increased stockholders’ equity by $3 million on August 19, 2026, as one step toward returning to NYSE American listing compliance.

citation.quote: On August 19, 2026, the Trust increased stockholders’ equity by $3 million, as one step toward returning to NYSE American listing compliance.
